status: Passed read-only projection and sampled geometric occlusion
scope: Actual projected continuous-head silhouette and conservative geometric occlusion at existing manual lower-face rows, aligned only by the two accepted iris centers. No geometry, albedo, camera or quality adoption.
limitations: Existing skin-only atlas bounds are manual approximations, not independently measured silhouette truth.
The full projected head boundary is evaluated from its indexed triangles. Occlusion probes are slightly inward at sampled rows, not all-pixel silhouette certification.
Closer hair triangles are reported conservatively without alpha/cutout or A2C visibility evaluation. Native overlay inspection must decide whether that material is visibly covering the outline.
Matching two irises removes scale, roll and translation; it does not establish correct yaw, depth or anatomy.
